clips.label: The Crystal Gate · 30 seconds
clips.note: The city gives way to a crystal gate, an ivory-tree canyon and a branching mineral world.
clips.details: Thirty continuous seconds at 24 fps and 1536×1024. The liked fourteen-second opening is preserved. Each new passage follows the actual preceding painting, with diagonal travel, local unfurling, sideways turns and outward reveals. All 270 paintings remain in the delivery; RIFE fills intervals outside feedback. Fine branches and clear contours survive, while some broad surfaces simplify. No cuts, masks or extra refinement.

clips.label: Beyond the crystal gate · 14 seconds
clips.note: The crystal opens into an orange-and-indigo canyon, then the camera sweeps sideways past ivory trees. Fine branching is visible; broad cliff faces remain smooth.
clips.details: Keeps the approved opening and adds 54 recurrent paintings across three passages: opening the crystal, crossing the threshold, and turning across the canyon. Forward travel changes into a sideways plane turn, bank and slight pullback. Krea 2 Turbo, Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1, adapter 0.25, reference boost 0.01 and grounding 768. Each repaint uses the already-moved previous painting for initialization and clean reference. RIFE finishing stays outside feedback. Fourteen continuous seconds, 24 fps, 1536×1024. No cuts, masks or extra refinement. Earlier versions remain available.

clips.label: Banking through the gate · 8 seconds
clips.note: A strong bank, sideways plane turn and curling lattice carry us around the cyan crystal. Fine surface detail still smooths out.
clips.details: The first 18 paintings are preserved; 54 new paintings begin after about two seconds. A 33-degree bank and 32-degree plane turn lead into a regional spiral around the crystal. The later pullback attempts produced unwanted lettering and are excluded from this selection. Krea 2 Turbo, Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1, adapter 0.25, reference boost 0.01 and grounding 768. Initialization and clean reference both use the already-moved previous painting. RIFE finishing remains outside feedback. Eight continuous seconds, 24 fps, 1536×1024. No cuts, masks or extra refinement. The original versions remain available.

clips.label: Through the crystal gate · 12 seconds
clips.note: The road continues into jade bands, copper branches and silver mineral trees. Fine distant detail remains soft; some small spheres near the ending become ball-like.
clips.details: The original 54 paintings are preserved, followed by 54 new recurrent paintings. The same Krea 2 Turbo recipe uses Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1, editing adapter 0.25, reference boost 0.01 and grounding 768. Only the already-moved previous painting supplies initialization and reference. Incoming camera speed is matched, then the push eases into a lateral glide with a gentle bank. RIFE finishing stays outside feedback. Twelve seconds at 24 fps, 1536×1024; no cuts or extra refinement. The original six-second draft remains available.

clips.label: The crystal gate · six-second draft
clips.note: Black stone and gold develop into a cyan/violet crystal gateway. Clear outlines and a persistent focal crystal; fine engraving still simplifies.
clips.details: Fresh opening B, followed by 53 recurrent paintings. Krea 2 Turbo, 1536×1024, Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1, editing adapter 0.25, reference boost 0.01 and grounding 768. Each repaint uses the already-moved previous painting for both partial-noise initialization and clean-reference conditioning. Material prompts change through the passage. RIFE finishing stays outside feedback; six seconds at 24 fps. No extra refinement pass, masks or fixed-opening reference. This is a new artistic passage, not a matched settings comparison with the earlier film.
